subject: 明代北方两层商铺，7×5格，灰砖硬山布货铺（原创扩展；细部待考）
footprint_basis: design/22 §3.4 bld_kit_ming_shop 7×5；同骨架两层地域变体
prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Texture and detail this exact architectural volume as a Ming dynasty north China TWO STOREY SHOP game sprite. Preserve exact camera projection, ground shape and silhouette of input, all ground and wall axes at +0.500 and -0.500 slopes. Do not change dimensions: footprint7 wide by5 deep, front lower edge1.4 times right lower edge. First floor has three small open shop bays and unmarked folded cloth; upper floor wooden lattice windows with a modest narrow balcony. Grey brick walls and wood framing, sober hard-gabled roof of grey semicylindrical clay tiles, gable end walls flush with roof with modest ridge caps, no curled up tips. Realistic antique painted strategy-map art, intricate weathered brickwork, wood grain, tile seams, sunlight upper left. Treat input as an exact blockout to materialize, not a loose inspiration. Finish thin grey paving over existing base polygon, no props or stairs outside perimeter. Transparent alpha0 background and transparent margins, no ground shadow outside footprint, no white background, no text, signs, logos, watermark, people or modern objects. Geometry is locked, material detail only.

references.role: 精确几何参考；已view_image；仅供image_gen重建

visual_review: 第2轮逐张view_image两候选，选本轮整体较优图；主体、底角完整，RGBA透明，光源左上。实测斜率与宽深比见repair-r2记录，仍未同时达到审核几何阈值，保留candidate；未做仿射或透视纠偏。
source_point_semantics: 可见薄石基脚L/F/R外缘顶点；取alpha>200下轮廓辅助定位，屋檐、台阶不作占地角
selection_reason: 两候选内优先保留形制与材料，并兼顾斜率和比例；未达标如实登记
negative: 排除项完整内嵌于prompt；工具无独立negative参数。
final_view_image_review: 第2轮已逐张view_image规范化成品：轮廓及底面完整，透明留边，左上光向、纹理密度可读；几何仍有已登记残差，尚不通过严格审核。
